{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Documentation updates (REST documentation and release notes) merely accompany the code changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not belong to docs because documentation changes are secondary to the txindex feature implementation."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Directly modifies src/index/txindex.cpp and src/index/txindex.h to lift the restriction against running txindex alongside pruning.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Resolves multiple long-standing feature requests (#10609, #12651, #16182, #35240) by allowing -txindex to operate on pruned nodes. Reviewers noted that running txindex on a pruned node is a 'huge improvement' that makes pruned nodes much more capable while drastically cutting storage requirements."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies JSON-RPC error handling (src/rpc/request.cpp, src/rpc/util.cpp) and updates getrawtransaction, gettxoutproof, and REST endpoints to return candidate block hashes in structured error data.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.38,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Extends RPC and REST error responses with structured candidate block hash data when target blocks are pruned, enabling clients to fetch missing blocks via getblockfrompeer."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test changes consist of functional tests specific to the txindex pruning feature rather than general test framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Does not belong to tests because the new and updated test files test txindex area behavior rather than framework machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits in src/init.cpp adjust startup argument validation to permit -txindex with -prune, which follows directly from the index change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not belong to utils because init changes are subordinate to enabling the feature in txindex."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 3,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
